From this, experienced here, Remove the dates to these, Let months dissolve in further months, And years exhale in years. Without certificate or pause Or celebrated days, As infinite our years would be As Anno Domini’s. From The Further Poems of Emily Dickinson (Little, Brown, and Company, 1929), edited by Martha Dickinson Bianchi and Alfred Leete Hampson.
